case_text: SYNTHETIC CASE (fictional). 47-year-old woman with 3 days of fever, productive cough, right-sided crackles and a right lower lobe consolidation on chest X-ray. Mild illness, alert, SpO2 95%, RR 20, BP 124/78. Her record says: anaphylaxis to penicillin (swelling of the throat and low blood pressure after amoxicillin, age 30).
evidence_topics: community-acquired pneumonia penicillin allergy alternative antibiotic

must_catch.why: Amoxicillin or another penicillin must be avoided.
